criteria.estimand: R6 = sum over the block's pairs of the best yield among the six transported conditions, divided by the sum of the best yield over the conditions that pair was measured on (at least 80% of the array's library, and always including all six panel members).

endpoints.F1_retention: R6 per block, with a paired bootstrap interval over pairs
endpoints.F2_random_six_percentile: the share of 20,000 random six-condition subsets of the block's measured conditions that the transported panel beats on R6
endpoints.F3_hit_recovery: among pairs whose reference best is at least 0.20, the share whose best within the six is at least 0.20
endpoints.F4_severe_loss: among pairs whose reference best exceeds 0, the share losing more than 0.20 absolute yield

resolvability_rule_fixed_before_scoring.effect: a block with fewer than 8 never-read pairs reaching 0.20 is reported UNRESOLVED and is excluded from every pooled figure
resolvability_rule_fixed_before_scoring.floor_of_the_whole_freeze: if fewer than two blocks are resolvable, the freeze reports UNRESOLVED as a whole

outcomes_fixed_in_advance.a_block_supports: F1 at or above 0.60 AND F2 at or above 0.90. Both are required: retention alone cannot distinguish a good panel from an easy block.
outcomes_fixed_in_advance.a_block_does_not_support: either condition fails; the manuscript then names the transformation and reports both numbers
outcomes_fixed_in_advance.direction: One-sided upward for F2 and F1: a panel above its threshold is support, and there is no upper bound at which support becomes failure.
outcomes_fixed_in_advance.why_F2_is_primary_here: Freeze 3 registered retention without a random baseline and its Suzuki block therefore counted as support at the 61st percentile of random sixes, beating them by 0.007. That will not recur under these criteria.

reported_alongside_every_value: the never-read pair count and the count reaching 0.20
